scope: One actual Docker loan using retained compiler keys and existing wallet; no Preview, swap, retry, faucet, registration, new wallet identity, compiler run or acceptance promotion.

proofAccounting.callbackMultiplicity: not established; no absolute HTTP count claimed
proofAccounting.resourceBound: single proof server under CPU/memory limits and independent outer Docker shutdown deadline; all internal SDK retries consume the same time/resources

roles.lenderBasis: Existing preprod public address re-encoded as local payout recipient only; no preprod request, secret read, signature or funding.

privatePreparation.newMaterial: Two random 32-byte contract capability secrets and one 32-byte random private-state password; not wallet identities
privatePreparation.existingSnapshots: Strict restore only, leave original bytes unchanged

network.protocolVersionRule: Actual local indexer public transaction data for retained dedicated wallet receipt; require exact existing transaction/block identity and node finality, not inferred package versions

storage.sourceBound: four payloads up to64MiB plus closed stage/event/results and new private LevelDB; retain privately, never copy SDK diagnostics or secrets into git
storage.cleanup: Retain all partial transaction records, reservations and private contract state; no evidence or wallet-state deletion.

stopOn: private file or restored identity mismatch
prerequisites: separate approved current launcher source reviews
fresh GPT-6 and Grok agreeing resource votes
record exact command arguments, plan hash and outer timer activation before wallet launch
priorCharges: Preserve all previous SP05 compilation and review attempts/timeouts plus canonical campaign debits; this is a distinct finite successor allocation, not reclaimed historical credit.
acceptance: Inner result stays INCOMPLETE if pinned SDK cannot report complete containment. Four matching stages + separately observed outer cleanup are scoped I2 observations only; no full SP05/Preview/PCD acceptance.
